access_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been accessed
access_count.title: 访问次数

created_at.description_en: The time when the share was created
created_at.title: 创建时间

disable_download.description_en: Specifies whether to disable downloading of files in the share
disable_download.description_zh: 禁止下载分享中的文件
disable_download.title: 禁止下载分享中的文件

disable_preview.description_en: Specifies whether to disable previewing of files in the share
disable_preview.description_zh: 禁止预览分享中的文件
disable_preview.title: 禁止预览分享中的文件

disable_save.description_en: Specifies whether to disable saving of files in the share
disable_save.description_zh: 禁止转存分享中的文件
disable_save.title: 禁止转存分享中的文件

download_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been downloaded
download_count.title: 下载次数

download_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be downloaded
download_limit.title: 分享下载次数限制

expiration.description_en: The expiration time. The value is in RFC 3339 format, for example, "2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00". An empty string ("") indicates that the share never expires
expiration.title: 到期时间

expired.description_en: Indicates whether the share has expired
expired.title: 是否过期

file_id_list.description_en: The list of file IDs in the shared parent path
file_id_list.title: 分享父路径文件id列表

office_editable.description_en: Specifies whether online editing of shared documents is allowed
office_editable.description_zh: 是否允许在线编辑分享的文档
office_editable.title: 是否允许在线编辑分享的文档

preview_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been previewed
preview_count.title: 预览次数

preview_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be previewed
preview_limit.title: 分享预览次数限制

report_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been reported
report_count.title: 被举报次数

save_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been saved
save_count.title: 转存次数

save_download_limit.description_en: The maximum total number of times the share can be saved and downloaded
save_download_limit.description_zh: 分享转存和下载次数总和限制
save_download_limit.title: 分享转存和下载次数总和限制

save_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be saved
save_limit.title: 分享转存次数限制

share_all_files.description_en: Indicates whether all files in the drive are shared
share_all_files.description_zh: 是否分享整个drive中的文件
share_all_files.title: 是否分享整个drive中的文件

share_name.description_en: The share name. By default, the name of the first file is used
share_name.description_zh: 分享名，默认使用第一个文件名
share_name.title: 分享名称

share_pwd.description_en: The extraction code, which is 0 to 64 characters in length. A length of 0 indicates that no extraction code is set
share_pwd.description_zh: 提取码，0-64个字符。长度0表示没有提取码
share_pwd.title: 分享密码

status.description_en:
The status of the share. Valid values:
disabled: Canceled.
enabled: Active
status.description_zh:
状态。
枚举值如下：
disabled（已取消）
enabled（有效）
status.title: 状态

updated_at.description_en: The time when the share was last modified
updated_at.title: 修改时间

video_preview_count.description_en: The number of times audio and video files in the share have been played
video_preview_count.title: 音视频播放次数

description_en: Retrieves information about a share link
name: GetShareLink

schema.description_en: The details of the share link
